cs.t: I use exactly this setup with a Logitech K830  https://www.logitech.com/en-ca/products/keyboards/k830-illum...  and I couldn't be happier. The keyboard is extremely robust (had it for about 10 years, spilt coffee on it once). You can sit on the sofa, surf normal websites on your TV using the setup, etc. Connect various external HDs for any downloadable content, run programs to do said downloading, use VLC, etc. I have a 1080p TV and run Windows at 200% on it, sure there's not that much room for content but for casual surfing and file browsing etc. it's fine.
cs.th: All the streaming boxes suck now
